Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
Hagar Stone attempts an action. Another vamipre plays Mask of 1000
Faces, untapping Hagar. Do I replace the Mask before Hagar untaps?

Hagar Stone
While Hagar is untapped, do not replace cards you play on your turn
until Hagar taps or your turn ends.

John Eno
